name: E-FCC
detailed_description:
Immerse yourself in the action with E-FCC, the official Fast Close Combat video game, now available on Steam! E-FCC brings you a realistic airsoft simulation experience, based on the innovative sport of Fast Close Combat (FCC). Take on your friends or other online players in intense 1-on-1 duels where every hit counts.

Key features: Competitive 1 vs 1 matches: Take on other online players in fast-paced, strategic battles where every hit counts as a point. The first player to win two sets of 30 points wins the match!

Authentic rules: Experience the adrenalin of FCC competition, with strict rules and penalties to ensure fair play. Each set begins with a 10-second countdown to prepare before the start, and lasts 45 seconds, with each elimination worth 10 points.

Realistic penalty system: Play by the rules or face penalties. Minor penalties for undeclared hits, intermediate penalties for players failing to declare despite the feel of the ball, and major penalties for cheating, leading to disqualification.

Immersive environment: Feel the tension of combat with realistic graphics and precise game physics. E-FCC faithfully recreates the intense, strategic experience of FCC combat.

Strategy and precision: Use stealth and strategy to surprise your opponent, but remain vigilant so as not to break the rules and suffer penalties. Every move counts, and every decision can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

Join the E-FCC community today and show off your Fast Close Combat skills!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-6600 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1400
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 / GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon™ RX 470
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
